target.title: feat(external): support macOS desktop credentials
target.body:
Replaces https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/976 after its stack base merged into main.

## Summary

- allow the generic `external` provider to keep `target: macos` and Windows targets instead of forcing Linux
- add external desktop credential config via username plus password environment variable name
- prefer provider-supplied desktop credentials for WebVNC before falling back to remote password commands
- document the generic macOS external-provider desktop setup and update provider matrix coverage

## Verification

- `go test ./internal/providers/external ./internal/providers/all`
- `go test ./internal/cli -run 'Test(ExternalDesktopCredentialsEnv|WebVNCCredentialsPreferProviderHook|IsMacOSDesktopProviderOnlyDedicatedMacOS|GuardMacOSDirectWebVNC|WebVNCBridgeArgsPreserveProviderRouting|WebVNCResetRemoteCommandHandlesWaylandAndX11)' -count=1`
- `bash scripts/check-docs.sh`
- `node scripts/generate-provider-matrix.mjs --check`
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`

## Security and configuration

Desktop passwords are not stored in config or passed on argv. The config stores only an environment variable name, and the provider reads the secret from the Crabbox process environment when WebVNC needs a handoff.
